en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of several large villa-style houses with steep, tiled roofs and ornate balconies, standing along the edge of a wooded area. In the foreground is an open meadow or field, with a few small figures visible in the grass. The buildings appear to be early-20th‑century European villas, possibly part of a residential or spa district on the edge of a town. The sky area at the top looks overexposed or cut out, as in an old photographic print. No printed caption or visible handwriting appears on the image side.
